page.content:
Director of Toy Story and longtime Pixar creative lead.

How John Lasseter connects

  • Work: Toy Story — Lasseter directed Toy Story.
  • Topic: Pixar — John Lasseter shaped Pixar's early features as director and creative lead.
  • Work: Luxo Jr. — Lasseter directed Luxo Jr.
  • Faction: Pixar Braintrust — Lasseter was a central voice in the early Braintrust.

What is John Lasseter?

John Lasseter directed Toy Story and A Bug's Life, shaped early Pixar taste, and was the studio's chief creative officer until 2018.

Key threads lead to Toy Story, Pixar, Luxo Jr. and Pixar Braintrust.
